name: openscreen
description: Record your screen, ship a demo. Free and open-source, GPU-accelerated, no watermarks, no subscriptions. Windows, macOS, Linux. Actively maintained.
readme_summary: OpenScreen is a free, open-source desktop application for recording and editing screen captures. It allows users to create polished product demos and walkthroughs with features like AI editing assistance, automatic captions, and customizable recording options.
key_features: Record specific windows or entire screen
Record microphone and system audio
Webcam overlay with various positioning and shape options
Auto or manual zooms with adjustable parameters
Customizable cursor effects and path smoothing
On-device automatic caption generation and editable transcripts
AI editing assistant for describing desired edits
Customizable backgrounds (wallpapers, colors, gradients, images)
Motion blur
Crop, trim, and per-segment speed control
primary_use_case: Creating polished product demos and walkthrough videos from screen recordings.
cover_image_prompt: A digital artist character in a minimalist studio, holding a magic wand that is simultaneously recording a computer screen and transforming the raw footage into a polished, animated presentation. The input is visualized as a stream of raw pixels flowing from a laptop screen, and the output is a vibrant, dynamic video playing on a larger monitor, complete with animated callouts and smooth zoom transitions. Subtle UI elements of OpenScreen, like a timeline and editing tools, are integrated into the studio's holographic displays. The scene is bright and modern, with a focus on creativity and ease of use. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a vibrant color palette, emphasizing the transformation from raw capture to professional demo.

name: tabatha
readme_summary: Tabatha is a Chrome extension that enhances tab management by providing live previews of all open tabs, enabling quick searching, and facilitating easy switching and reopening of closed tabs. It aims to replicate the familiar Alt+Tab functionality for web browser tabs.
key_features: Live tab previews
Search open and recently closed tabs
Reopen recently closed tabs and windows
Unified view of tabs across all windows
Support for tab groups
Customizable shortcuts
Private and local data storage
primary_use_case: Improving the efficiency and user experience of managing multiple Chrome browser tabs.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, magical librarian character, embodying 'Tabatha', stands in a grand, organized library filled with countless glowing books representing browser tabs. The librarian uses a large, ornate magnifying glass to peer into each book, revealing a miniature, live scene of the book's content within the lens. Surrounding the librarian are shelves neatly organizing recently closed books, and a spectral 'window' showing a catalog of all books. Subtle digital particles and faint code snippets float in the air, connecting the library to the digital realm. The scene is brightly lit with a warm, inviting glow, rendered in a detailed 3D isometric illustration style.

name: client
description: Tetiva — desktop API client for HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL and WebSocket (Wails v3 + Vue 3)
readme_summary: Tetiva is a desktop API client for HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSocket, built with Go and Vue. It offers a local-first, offline-capable experience with optional cloud sync, providing a fast and private alternative to existing tools.
key_features: Support for HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSocket protocols
Local-first architecture with SQLite database for offline functionality
Collections, environments, history, and scripting capabilities
Postman v2.1 import/export
Optional real-time cloud sync
MCP server for AI client integration
Built with Wails 3 (Go backend, Vue 3 frontend)
primary_use_case: A desktop application for developers to interact with and test various network protocols (HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket) locally and efficiently.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan, the 'Tetiva', meticulously crafting intricate digital blueprints on a workbench. The blueprints represent different network protocols (HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket) as glowing, interconnected circuits. The artisan uses specialized tools that resemble stylized cursors and code snippets to assemble these circuits, transforming raw data streams (visualized as flowing energy) into organized, functional structures. Small, subtle UI elements of the Tetiva application are integrated into the workbench. The scene is set in a clean, modern workshop with soft, focused lighting, emphasizing precision and clarity. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, vibrant color palette, conveying innovation and developer empowerment.

name: cluster-sentinel
description: All-in-one Kubernetes observability toolkit for cluster events, metrics, alerting, and monitoring — with Prometheus alerts, Grafana dashboards, and Helm deployment included.
readme_summary: Cluster Sentinel is a Rust-based observability toolkit for Kubernetes that monitors cluster events, persists them in SQLite, and provides metrics and an API. It includes Prometheus alerts, Grafana dashboards, and Helm deployment for comprehensive cluster event management and analysis.
key_features: Watches Kubernetes Events
Persists event history in SQLite
Maintains a bounded in-memory read cache
Exposes Prometheus metrics
Provides a read-only HTTP API
Includes an embedded MCP server
Offers Docker image and Helm chart for deployment
Includes Prometheus alert rules and Grafana dashboard
primary_use_case: To provide comprehensive observability for Kubernetes clusters by monitoring, storing, and exposing cluster events, metrics, and alerts.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant lighthouse keeper on a rocky shore, diligently watching over a vast, stormy sea filled with numerous small ships (representing Kubernetes events). The lighthouse beam (Cluster Sentinel) sweeps across the sea, illuminating and cataloging each ship with a glowing icon, while a detailed logbook (SQLite database) lies open beside the keeper, recording every sighting. In the background, a subtle digital interface displays real-time ship movements and alerts. The scene is rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style, with a dramatic, moody lighting that emphasizes the importance of constant vigilance and data recording. The overall composition is clean and focused, highlighting the lighthouse as the central element of observation and safety.

name: Shelter-Humanizer
description: AI-assisted text editor for Windows with local LLM support, text rewriting, style improvement and Unicode cleanup.
readme_summary: Shelter Humanizer is a Windows-based AI-assisted text editor that enhances writing by removing clichés, improving phrasing, and cleaning up Unicode characters. It supports local LLM integration for offline processing and offers features for style analysis and comparison.
key_features: AI-assisted text rewriting and style improvement
Local LLM support (Ollama, DeepSeek, Qwen)
Unicode cleanup and character checking
Text comparison and change tracking
Preservation of numbers, quotes, links, and selected terms
Customizable text processing settings
Light/dark themes and hotkeys
primary_use_case: Improving and cleaning text content using AI, with a focus on local LLM processing for privacy and offline use.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled scribe sitting at an ornate wooden desk, holding a quill that glows with digital energy. The scribe is transforming a messy, tangled scroll filled with archaic symbols and smudged ink into a clean, crisp, and elegantly written document. Floating around the desk are subtle UI elements showing text comparison, character codes, and a small, stylized AI brain icon. The background is a cozy, dimly lit study with a hint of modern technology integrated into the bookshelves. The overall mood is one of refinement and intelligent assistance. The art style should be a detailed digital painting with clear outlines and a warm, inviting color palette, emphasizing the transformation from chaos to clarity.
